articles.title: Zcash jumps 48% to over $800 as Grayscale spot ETF push adds to ‘next bitcoin’ buzz
articles.snippet: ZEC traded above its January 2018 peak as futures volume hit billions of dollars and a Grayscale filing showed fresh progress toward converting its Zcash Trust into a spot ETF.

articles.title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
articles.snippet: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.

articles.title: Nearly 2,000 Hacked WordPress Sites Turned Into Criminal Infrastructure
articles.snippet: The StopAndProtect operation used compromised WordPress websites to spread malware, steal crypto wallet files, and deploy ransomware.
